# Metsäinfo

> Metsäinfo shows Finnish forest resource data (metsävaratiedot) for any property on a map. Tap a cadastral parcel or enter a property ID (kiinteistötunnus) to see forest land area, stands (kuviot), growing stock volume, tree species, age, growth, sawlog and pulpwood volumes, and the Finnish Forest Centre's cutting and silviculture recommendations. It runs in the browser and as iPhone, iPad and Android apps, and comes with an MCP server that gives AI assistants the same data by property ID.

Key facts:

- Data comes live from open APIs: Finnish Forest Centre (Suomen metsäkeskus) forest stand WFS and National Land Survey of Finland (Maanmittauslaitos) INSPIRE cadastral parcel WFS, both CC BY 4.0. Coordinates are EPSG:3067 (ETRS-TM35FIN).
- The web app runs entirely in the browser: no backend, no account, no ads. The user interface is in Finnish. Location is processed only on the device.
- Free in the web app and the mobile apps: property search, summary, stand list, cutting and silviculture recommendations, map colouring and layers, own location, link, CSV and print. The mobile apps sell one paid add-on as a one-time purchase: a timber sale price estimate (puukaupan hinta-arvio) based on current regional stumpage prices.
- Property IDs are accepted as `999-1-1-1` or as the 14-digit form `99900100010001` (this example ID is fictional). A property opens directly with `https://trotor.github.io/metsainfo/?parcel=<kiinteistötunnus>`.
- Metsäinfo is an independent app by Inetor Oy, not an official product of the Finnish Forest Centre or the National Land Survey. Source code is MIT licensed.

## App

- [Metsäinfo web app](https://trotor.github.io/metsainfo/): Map with property search; add `?parcel=<kiinteistötunnus>` to open a property
- [Metsäinfo on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/fi/app/id6832988855): iPhone and iPad
- [Metsäinfo on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=fi.inetor.metsainfo): Android
- [Product page](https://inetor.fi/metsainfo/): Metsäinfo at Inetor Oy
- [Privacy policy and data licences](https://trotor.github.io/metsainfo/tietosuoja.html): In Finnish; what the app stores and every data source with its licence

## MCP server

- [mcp-server/](https://github.com/trotor/metsainfo/tree/main/mcp-server): FastMCP (Python) server over stdio; not hosted, run it locally. From the repository root: `uv run --with fastmcp --with certifi fastmcp run mcp-server/server.py` (requires uv). It queries the Metsäkeskus and Maanmittauslaitos WFS services live.
- [server.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trotor/metsainfo/main/mcp-server/server.py): Two tools, both taking `kiinteistotunnus: str`. `hae_metsavaratieto` returns a human-readable Finnish summary (area, volume, species shares, development and fertility classes, cutting and silviculture recommendations, stand list, measurement year). `hae_raakadata` returns JSON with `kiinteistotunnus`, `palstoja` (number of parcel parts), `statistics` and `features` (per-stand properties without geometry, codes decoded into `*_NAME` fields). Errors come back as Finnish messages (invalid ID, property not found, no forest data).
- [.mcp.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trotor/metsainfo/main/.mcp.json): Claude Code configuration in the repository root; for Claude Desktop use the same command with an absolute path to `mcp-server/server.py`
- [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/): The protocol the server implements
- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/): Python package runner used to start the server

## Data sources

- [Suomen metsäkeskus: open forest and nature data](https://www.metsakeskus.fi/fi/avoin-metsa-ja-luontotieto): Forest stands, habitats of special importance, forest use declarations, CC BY 4.0
- [Metsäkeskus stand WFS](https://avoin.metsakeskus.fi/rajapinnat/v1/stand/ows?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities): Forest stands (`v1:stand`), EPSG:3067, at most about 2000 features per request
- [Maanmittauslaitos INSPIRE cadastral parcel WFS](https://inspire-wfs.maanmittauslaitos.fi/inspire-wfs/cp/ows?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities): Property boundaries (`cp:CadastralParcel`), CC BY 4.0
- [KOODISTO.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trotor/metsainfo/main/KOODISTO.md): Metsäkeskus code lists (tree species, development class, fertility class, cutting types and more) used to decode numeric fields
- [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): Licence of the forest and cadastral data

## Source code

- [GitHub: trotor/metsainfo](https://github.com/trotor/metsainfo): Web app (Vite, Leaflet, Proj4Leaflet), iOS and Android apps (Capacitor) and the MCP server, MIT
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trotor/metsainfo/main/README.md): Features, data sources and MCP setup, in Finnish
- [Issues](https://github.com/trotor/metsainfo/issues): Bug reports and feedback

## Optional

- [Accessibility index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trotor/metsainfo/main/docs/saavutettavuusindeksi.md): How the stand accessibility score 0–100 is calculated, in Finnish
- [Kapsi map tiles](https://kartat.kapsi.fi/): Background maps from Maanmittauslaitos data
- [Luonnonvarakeskus](https://www.luke.fi/): Stumpage price statistics used by the price estimate, together with Metsäteollisuus ry's weekly timber trade monitoring
- [Inetor Oy](https://inetor.fi): Developer of Metsäinfo
